item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 22/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine and persistently very hot over southern China in the next few days. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
